svg.text: Galileo — The Verifiable AI Wallet on 0G
Every intent is TEE-attested, user-confirmed, executed on-chain, and independently auditable from 0G Storage.
🛡️ Galileo refuses to move money unless the intent is verifiable.
One dominant primitive — every value-moving action travels these 6 steps. Remove any step and Galileo cannot credibly claim to be a verifiable AI wallet.

① No new wallet features unless they strengthen proof, safety, or 0G dependency. ② Every feature must answer: what breaks if 0G is removed? ③ Every live demo must end with a public verification link, not a claim.
Tool Executor src/ai/toolExecutor.ts · 23 LLM-callable tools — value-moving tools only STAGE an action + receipt (never execute without Confirm)
Sends and imports are NOT AI tools — deterministic command + Confirm-button flows so private keys never reach the LLM

g.text: The dominant primitive — no value moves without one
staged pre-Confirm → finalized post-tx → uploaded to 0G Storage
cancelReceipt() / failReceipt() on Cancel or tx revert
emitted in one shot (no staging) — creation + each execution
createKeyRevealReceipt() — LOCAL-ONLY, never uploaded to 0G Storage

svg.text: uploadJson("receipt:<id>", receipt) → rootHash indexed in OG_RECEIPT_INDEX_PATH
0G DECENTRALIZED STACK — required before sensitive actions execute

g.text: Remove this → no hardware-attested proof. A reply could be tampered with.
Remove this → no immutable receipt home. A judge cannot verify anything.
Remove this → no deterministic settlement for the executed intent.
🌐 PUBLIC PROOF CENTER · every action ends with a verification link, not a claim
A judge can verify any receipt from a browser by root hash — no Telegram access, no screenshots, no trust required.
Each 0G layer is annotated with: what breaks if 0G is removed? · Remove any one layer and Galileo cannot credibly claim to be a verifiable AI wallet.
